Name: BumperHarvestOfSauerkraut
Author: MoYuCSC
Description:
[b]Bumper Harvest of Sauerkraut[/b] adds a new way to make use of withered crops after the season ends. Instead of letting them rot away, you can now use your scythe to harvest wilted plants and obtain [b]Sauerkraut Leaves[/b]. These leaves are classified as a vegetable and can be placed into a Preserves Jar to produce [b]Sauerkraut Cans[/b] (using the vanilla artisan system).
The real twist comes when you ship those Sauerkraut Cans via the shipping bin. For every 100 cans sold in a single season, the prices of [b]all other goods[/b] (excluding the Sauerkraut Can itself) will increase by 5% in the following season. If you sell 200 or more cans, the price bonus reaches its maximum of 10%.
At the start of each new season, the game will notify you of any active price bonuses, so you can plan your farming and sales accordingly.

[b]酸菜大丰收[/b] 为过季后的枯萎作物提供了全新的用途。你不再需要看着它们烂在地里——现在只需手持镰刀，收割那些枯萎的作物，就能获得 [b]酸菜叶[/b]。酸菜叶属于蔬菜类别，你可以将其放入罐头罐中，利用原版工匠系统加工成 [b]酸菜罐头[/b]。
真正的亮点在于出货：当你在一个季度内通过出货箱售出的酸菜罐头数量累计达到 100 个时，下一个季度所有其他商品（酸菜罐头自身除外）的售价将上涨 5%；若售出 200 个或以上，价格加成将达到最高 10%。
每个新季度开始时，游戏会显示当前的价格加成状态，帮助你更好地规划种植与销售策略。
